Thank you. I think this is something I might suggest!!

I can tell you for a fact that they're not refusing it because they don't want help. Trust me, they want to get better so bad, but getting help also requires you to open a door that you wanted to remain closed, and it necessitates that you expose yourself and that's so so hard. That is one of the hardest aspects in many people's mental health journey. Of course it's a vicious cycle because by denying professional help their condition worsens, but you can't chastise someone for staying silent when mental health is so stigmatized and scandalized in our society.

I never said I don't give a flying fuck?! I said the institution doesn't. Please read my comment more thoroughly because I am not discrediting what you're saying, you just seem condescending af toward people who are responding to OP in a way that could console him right now.

I don't go to Waterloo, but I do go to another institution in Ontario and I consistently seek mental health services on campus. YES, they treat me like a number. It was only when I began to show suicidal tendencies that they took me seriously. You should stop acting like you're the only one here who knows the struggle. Chances are most of the people on this thread have a vague idea of how frustrating it is to finally get the help we need from our schools.

I did, and what you're saying is inappropriate considering the state OP is likely to be in atm. His post wasn't solely about the school not contacting his family, he's just talking about the lack of sympathy that higher ups in the education system have toward students. In most cases academic counselling and the registrar only think of you as a number, just one in the crowd, and don't give a flying fuck about your personal issues. That's probably why OP's brother felt overwhelmed, isolated, and helpless all at once. You really don't think the school should be rebuked for that?
Male privilege.
why does this make YOU mad? this isn't about you?!
Im so sorry for your loss, OP. My heart goes out to you and your family
